authority: preregistered response-blind net-zero near-interface redistribution state construction
scientific_question: Can a net-zero redistribution confined to the two bottom compartments construct an H16-separated direction twin while driving total-profile and upper-30-cm storage matching below the E07 1e-9 cm ceiling, ideally to numerical equality?
rationale: E08 supports interface memory at 1e-9 cm aggregate-storage resolution.
E07 showed that the node-6/node-16 basis leaks a small but nonzero signal into root30 and has no qualifying twin at 1e-10 cm.
Moving both source and sink to nodes 15 and 16 introduces a genuinely new local near-interface basis that is farther from the root zone while retaining direct leverage on H16.

forcing_semantics.net_internal_forcing: exact equal positive qssdi source and qdra sink magnitudes per interval

execution_contract: each direction/fraction/step family starts from the same fresh B01 Se=0.85 origin
derive K0 from the fresh seed
qssdi is nonzero only at the preregistered source node and qdra level 1 only at the preregistered sink node
only fully completed strict families contribute endpoints
one physical advance per interval; no fallback, retry, temporal subdivision, tolerance relaxation or direct state mutation
failed intervals terminate the family and preserve the latest committed origin
emit only family provenance and committed H/theta for selection

response_blind_selection.pair_scope: only LOCAL_UP versus LOCAL_DOWN twins with the same transfer fraction and accepted step count
response_blind_selection.selected_rung: EXACT if numeric equality of W_profile and W_root30 has a qualifying pair; otherwise tightest qualifying numeric rung
response_blind_selection.no_match: Close E09 NO_MATCH without adding nodes, amplitudes, durations or relaxing H16/storage gates.

qualification_gates: complete mass accounting with |residual|<=1e-12 cm for candidate intervals
selected pair persisted with all 16 H/theta values before response work
next_if_selected: Preregister GC-RZM06E10 using the immutable E09 pair and the unchanged forcing-free fixed-Hc response probe, with interpretation bounded to the selected storage rung unless EXACT is selected.
next_if_no_match: Close this local basis; derive a different prospective multi-basis construction rather than retuning E09.
nonclaims: qssdi/qdra remain research state-construction channels only.
A selected pair alone is not response-memory evidence.
No production reduced-state, second MODFLOW state or coupling change is admitted.
